why: Taken as printed (the id is the join key); not corrected. b1ce1334's independent read labels the out-of-sequence block as NBA Cup group games on nba.com; that labelling is observed on the page, not verified against an official Cup document.
action_needed: None for correctness (ids are join keys, taken verbatim). If Cup-group labelling matters for factor modelling (neutral-site games?), verify against an official NBA Cup schedule source.

item: The official injury-report index lags the CDN: the 12:45 AM ET revision resolved on the CDN at 2026-11-19T05:47Z while the index still listed only the 12:30 AM report at the same time.
why: A freshness rule keyed to the index would have missed the newest revision; the capture took the newest revision from the CDN probe instead and recorded both states.
action_needed: The hosted refresh's injury fetch should probe the CDN for the newest revision and use the index as corroboration, not as the sole freshness source. Until that is implemented, index-only freshness claims are an upper bound.

item: No archived injury revision exists in the repository between 11/16 01:30 PM ET and 11/19 12:30 AM ET.
why: The scheduled refresh has been red since 11/17 (EVE-F04), so the 11/17-11/18 filing windows were never captured. The gap is recorded as a gap, not bridged; consecutive-report diffs across it are impossible by construction.
action_needed: Once the hosted refresh runs green again (root cause fixed in #146), archive revisions resume; the gap itself cannot be back-filled because the older revisions are no longer on the CDN. Any strategy whose injury-delta factor claims the 11/17-11/18 window must disclose this hole.

item: 12:45 AM revision: 9 POR@MIL rows with date/time blank; 2 rows (Kuminga, Pullin) with matchup and team blank; 6 rows with status missing; 10 keyed rows unreadable in the text layer.
why: The stored artefacts are the fetch-tool text layers of the official PDFs (the PDF binary is not reachable from the sandbox), and the text layer drops cells. Unreadable rows are reported as unreadable, never inferred.
action_needed: When the hosted refresh can fetch PDF binaries, re-parse the same revisions from the real PDFs and reconcile against these text-layer transcriptions.

item: Records printed on the nba.com games pages are as of the retrieval time and are not reconciled with the 11/16 snapshot.
why: The pages print each team's season record next to the game; those strings were read but not re-derived from a standings source in that round.
